text: My daily routine is simple but consistent, which helps me stay productive. I wake up at six-thirty every morning, and my first habit is drinking a glass of water before making coffee. After a quick breakfast, I start work at eight. I usually spend the morning answering emails and focusing on important tasks. Around noon, I take a short break for lunch. In the afternoon, I continue with meetings and projects. When work ends at five, I go for a thirty-minute run or do some stretching at home. Evenings are for cooking dinner, reading, and watching a show. I try to be in bed by ten-thirty, so I feel rested for the next day.
